title: E0030: Cyclomatic Complexity Density
plain_english: Reports methods where decision-making logic is densely packed into a small number of lines.
why_matters: Cyclomatic complexity density measures how much branching occurs per line of code. A short method can still be difficult to understand if most lines contain decisions.
what_it_checks: Applies to concrete methods in classes, traits, and enums.
Reports when density is greater than `max_density`.
